description: Jet 4 MDB: 2mww draft TableDef & Field default property reads and invalid put / Append error matrix: reads fresh draft TableDef & Field properties; tests AllowZeroLength=True on Long, Attributes=16 on Text, two AutoIncr Longs, invalid Attributes (-1, 9999), invalid OrdinalPosition (-1, 32768), invalid Field ValidationRule syntax & cross-column ref, ValidationText without ValidationRule, invalid DefaultValue syntax, TableDef ValidationRule referencing missing column, Field Size -1 & 256 (Text), CreateField bad Type/Size, and CreateProperty/Properties.Append on draft TableDef & Field before Append. Keeps all pages before/after failures and Close to observe any 0xE02 or page allocation on refused Append.
